messages:
rebecca_sales: Quick ask — Venture Health (seed, clinical analytics) wants a 10-week hosted pilot to validate embeddings + conversational summarization. They estimate a spike to ~220k tokens/week for batch runs and want promotional credits to prevent early throttling. Requested: $9,000 credits + 60-day extended metrics retention. Deal link: https://redwood.internal/deals/VH-309

noah_se: Tech note — embeddings will dominate cost. Recommend initial run on the small-embedding model and aggressive batching. SE can supply a reduced harness to cap token usage. Ballpark hosted spend if unbounded: $7k–$11k for 10 weeks; with staged ramp we can keep it near $4k–$6k.

ivan_dealdesk: Heads-up — discretionary promo pool covers up to $6k without exec signoff. Need the usual fields before we approve: exact credit amount, pilot start/end, hosted vs Dedicated, data sensitivity & signed docs, desired promo expiration. Anything >$6k requires VP exception.

rebecca_sales: Filling details now: requested $9,000 credits; pilot window 2026-06-01 to 2026-08-09 (10 weeks); hosted only, no Dedicated/KMS; data: de-identified clinical notes per their legal. NDA signed, DPA in progress.

marta_security: We need DPA before any real clinical data enters platform. For de-identified sets we can allow early runs if they provide dataset attestation and a small sample. Logs/metrics retention for 60 days is OK if included in the MOU. Also request we disable raw-note telemetry in early runs.

sam_finance: Finance note — promos >$5k affect revenue recognition and require RevOps entry. We need a billing promo code created with explicit expiry and GL mapping. Please route promo creation to billing@redwood and cc finance. GL: PROMO/2026/Q2. Who owns follow-up?

ivan_dealdesk: Deal Desk proposal: offer $6,000 hosted credits (discretionary) + a conversion incentive: 30% off first month if they commit to a 12-month Dedicated reservation within 60 days of pilot end. Extend metrics retention to 60 days. DPA required before any sensitive data. If the customer insists on $9k we escalate to @oliver_vp for a one-off.

rebecca_sales: I'll present the $6k + 30% conversion incentive. We prefer to avoid escalation if the customer can stage runs to fit the credits. I'll ask them to agree to a staged ramp and to share a sample dataset for security attestation.

noah_se: For the pilot harness, here's the suggested minimal config to reduce cost:

```
model: redwood/embedding-small-v1
batch_size: 64
max_tokens_per_call: 256
stream: false
```

This prioritizes embedding throughput and keeps summary generation to sampled documents.

ivan_dealdesk: Conditional approval: $6,000 hosted credits, 60-day metrics retention, pilot dates as submitted, promo expires 45 days after pilot start. DPA must be signed before any non-anonymized data. For escalation to $9k, provide VP brief with estimated ARR and conversion likelihood.

marta_security: Confirmed — no PHI before DPA. We can provision isolated telemetry and a synthetic-test ramp early. Please attach attestation and sample dataset to the deal folder.

sam_finance: Approved to create $6k promo code pending billing ticket. Email billing@redwood with deal id VH-309 and cc finance@redwood. GL code above.

ivan_dealdesk: Status updated in deal tracker: "promo-approved - conditional". @rebecca_sales please upload DPA and MOU. If customer pushes for $9k escalate to @oliver_vp.

oliver_vp: If Venture Health demonstrates clear product-market fit signals during pilot (high eval accuracy + conversion intent), I can approve up to $9k as a one-time exception, but only with a short business case (expected ARR, timeline, and AE endorsement). Otherwise $6k + conversion incentive is the standard approval.

rebecca_sales: Thanks team — I'll present the $6k offer with the conversion incentive and the staged ramp plan. Will return with customer response and upload DPA when signed. :thumbsup
